# Ride and Develop

> Ride and Develop (radtrails.org) is a nonprofit that enhances mental well-being through mountain bike racing and outdoor recreation. It fields the Langtown Racing Academy team, offers paid coaching and guided-ride services across Ventura County, Northern LA County, and Santa Cruz, runs community programs, and accepts donations. Audience: prospective riders and families, students, donors, and anyone seeking MTB coaching or guiding.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://radtrails.org/): Organization overview — mission and vision, intro to Langtown Racing Academy, service and community highlights, and a photo gallery.
- [Services](https://radtrails.org/services): Instruction and guide services with pricing (private and group lessons, training programs, guided rides and clinics) plus coach profiles.
- [Racing](https://radtrails.org/racing): Langtown Racing Academy — featured racer, current team roster with bios and sponsors, the Langtown racing legacy, and service location.
- [Alumni](https://radtrails.org/racing/alumni): Former Langtown Racing Academy team members.
- [Community](https://radtrails.org/community): Community pillars (trail service, outreach, belonging) and ways to get involved.
- [Support](https://radtrails.org/support): How to donate (via Givelify) and a contact form for inquiries.

## Secondary Resources

- [Account Profile](https://radtrails.org/profile): Authenticated rider profile editor (name, photo, bio, social links); edits are moderated before publication.
- [Coach Dashboard](https://radtrails.org/coach): Authenticated coach tools for scheduling, team events, and rider management.
- [Admin](https://radtrails.org/admin): Authenticated admin area for reviewing profiles and granting personas (includes /admin/setup, /admin/personas, and /admin/profiles/manage).
- [API](https://radtrails.org/api): JSON endpoints for Google OIDC auth, public profiles, coach scheduling, account data, a calendar feed, and admin actions — for machine use, not human browsing.
